paths.description: User shifted from following others' expectations and predefined paths to consciously choosing their own direction and trusting their navigation
paths.reasoning: Clear T1 pattern: understanding (of being trapped in others' expectations) meets challenge (the hike experience) → resistance (decision to go off-trail). Clear T2 pattern: resistance reveals threshold (between following and choosing), creating conscious choice to transform. Domain matches somatic (body) - transformation happened through embodied hiking experience, physical movement, and sensory awareness.

paths.description: User moved from performing/constructing an identity to authentic being and presence
paths.reasoning: T1 pattern: letting go (of constructed identity) leads to stillness (mountain experience) → presence (authentic being). T2 pattern: presence reveals being itself, creating authenticity. Domain matches somatic (body) - transformation centered on embodied presence and physical experience of 'being' rather than thinking.
